description: Lightweight internal investigation truth pack focused on witnesses, entities, chronology, and inconsistency handling.

documents.name: Hotline Report
documents.text: 2024-04-03 Anonymous hotline report alleged that procurement lead Dana Cho steered HelioTech vendor work to Meridian Labs without review.

documents.name: Witness Interview - Omar Reed
documents.text: 2024-04-08 Omar Reed said Dana Cho asked him to skip the normal vendor scoring process for Meridian Labs because the launch timeline was tight.

documents.name: Procurement Log
documents.text: 2024-04-10 The procurement log showed Meridian Labs received emergency approval before the vendor scoring worksheet was completed.

documents.name: Dana Cho Statement
documents.text: 2024-04-12 Dana Cho denied bypassing review and stated that Meridian Labs was selected only after standard scoring was complete.

known_contradictions.claim_a: Omar Reed said Dana Cho asked him to skip normal vendor scoring.
known_contradictions.claim_b: Dana Cho denied bypassing review and said scoring was complete first.

ambiguities.notes: The procurement log confirms emergency approval timing but does not identify who authorized it.

golden_questions.question: Which witness supports the claim that vendor scoring was skipped?
What evidence conflicts with Dana Cho's statement?

memo_topics.issue: Whether vendor review was bypassed for Meridian Labs
